stories.h: Eisenkot reportedly eyes Knesset vote on minority government
stories.s: Yashar leader Gadi Eisenkot reportedly plans to bring a government to a Knesset vote before his mandate expires, even a minority coalition relying on Arab parties. Liberman opposes it and Likud called it shocking.

stories.h: Report: Netanyahu had Mossad plan Iran op without IDF
stories.s: The Washington Post reports Netanyahu asked Mossad chief Roman Gofman before the October election to prepare a covert Iran operation without telling the cabinet or IDF chief. An Israeli security official called it false.

stories.h: IAF strikes Hezbollah underground missile site in Beqaa
stories.s: Israeli jets hit the entrances of an underground Hezbollah missile production and storage site near Janta in eastern Lebanon, the second Beqaa strike in a week. No casualties were immediately reported.

stories.h: IDF raids beyond Gaza Yellow Line to demolish tunnel
stories.s: Troops spent a day inside the Hamas-held part of central Gaza destroying a tunnel section that crossed the Yellow Line. The Salah a-Din highway has since reopened.

stories.h: Israeli banks freeze settler council's accounts after UK sanctions
stories.s: The Har Hebron Regional Council head says two Israeli banks froze its foreign-currency accounts after Britain sanctioned eight settlement construction firms, one linked to the council.

coming.h: Likud and Yashar hold second round of coalition talks
coming.s: Likud says a second round of unity talks with Eisenkot's Yashar party is set for Sunday.

coming.h: Bank of Israel interest rate decision
coming.s: The Monetary Committee announces its next rate decision; it held at 3.25% last time.

coming.h: Attorney general appears before Netanyahu trial judges
coming.s: The attorney general's court-ordered appearance in Netanyahu's corruption trial was moved to Wednesday.
